messages:
Lina (PM): Quick follow-up from today's all-hands: can we get a short FAQ for PMs about the microbatch+adaptive rollout? Need bullets for benefits, risks, and opt-in steps.
Rohit (Eng): Benefits: ~8-12% median token latency win on long-running text-gen; better GPU utilization. Risks: p95 can increase for heavy long-seq mixes unless adaptive window applied. Opt-in: route config key for alpha.
Kai (Kernel): Kernel note: attention-fuse v5 has a 4-bit quant edge-case; we'll ship with a safe fallback in canary. That fallback preserves correctness but reduces throughput ~4%.
Lina (PM): Can you paste exact opt-in config we should show to customers?
Rohit (Eng): Example: {"adaptive_batching": true, "batch_window_ms": 10} (we'll document defaults and alpha caveats).
Diego (Ops): SRE/ops ask: concrete rollback triggers please.
sre-bot: Suggested triggers: p95 > +7% vs baseline for 20m OR KV hit-rate drop >10% absolute. If triggered, follow canary rollback runbook.
Lina (PM): Perfect. Who will draft the release blurb?
Rohit (Eng): I'll draft and open PR to docs tonight, will paste link here when ready.
Kai (Kernel): Assigned RNW-1402 to track adaptive-window prototype (est 4d).
Diego (Ops): I'll update runbook with the alert thresholds and tag SRE on-call. Closing thread once PR and perf link posted.
